title: Mammoth wool for the winter
Shear a mammoth
summary: The tailors of {settlement} want {count} × mammoth wool ({item}) for winter coats. Mammoths roam the snowfields; shear one.
offer: Nothing keeps out the cold like mammoth wool. The herds are on the snowfields; shear me {count} × {item}. Gently, mind: they kick.
complete: Feel that. That's a winter's warmth, that is.
